At least 23 people are killed and others are injured as heavy clashes breaks out across the South West State of Somalia, as forces loyal to former president Abdiaziz Laftagareen launch a major armed assault on troops of Aden Madobe and Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. [2]

At least 24 people, including the former secretary of the National Security and Defence Council, Volodymyr Horbulin, are injured and three are killed by Russian drone strikes on the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine building, a health clinic, and a residential building in Kyiv, Ukraine [3]

Polish military jets are scrambled in response to Russian airstrikes on Ukraine. [4]
